validation.selection_note: Exploratory model selection on these folds; the folds are not an untouched final estimate. The saved baseline used the same folds.

feature_engineering.missingness_flags: raw source columns with training missing values

feature_selection.method: fold-1 permutation importance, validated on folds 2-5

submission.gamma_gt_prediction_method: POC_Batch mean log-residual correction with tuned HGB post-correction (75% adjustment scale)

ggt_batch_correction.batch_correction: Mean training-fold residual on log1p(Gamma_GT) - log1p(POC_GGT) for each observed POC_Batch.
ggt_batch_correction.fallback: HistGradientBoostingRegressor predicts the log-target for rows without usable POC, and predicts the POC residual when POC exists but the batch correction is unavailable.

post_correction.target: POC log-residual minus leave-one-out batch mean residual

cross_validation.selection_note: Exploratory model selection on these folds; not an untouched final estimate.

Gamma_GT.model: POC batch correction with Histogram-GB fallback

feature_selection.method: Held-out-fold permutation importance on fold 1, followed by full-versus-reduced comparison on folds 2-5.

leaderboard_feedback.interpretation: Leaderboard scores were reported by the user. Per-target leaderboard metrics are unavailable; do not treat inferred metrics as measured validation results.

ggt_two_stage_candidate.method: Fold-local CatBoost primary and POC-free fallback; replace known-batch rows with training-fold mean Gamma_GT/POC_GGT multipliers when POC_GGT > 3.

comparison.selection_note: Exploratory fold comparisons. The leaderboard score for this candidate is unknown until submitted.
